external_boundary: Transport calls suspend; a caller supplies replies or DeliveryError. TCP is outside this model.
retry_boundary: backoff exponential full-jitter delays are explicit external suspensions; no wall-clock or fairness assumption
source_schema: finite acyclic integer-JSON values (null, bool, int, Unicode scalar strings, lists, string-keyed dictionaries), plus internal integer-keyed containers, tuples, records, and declared external objects; floats and custom Python objects are outside this profile
